name: Do I need a Level 5 drywall finish in my basement, or is standard finish enough?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a Level 5 drywall finish in my basement, or is standard finish enough?

acceptedAnswer.text: A smoother finish hides seams better, but it costs more and takes more labor. For most basements, a standard finish is enough; a Level 5-style finish makes sense when you want flatter walls, glossier paint, or lighting that will reveal imperfections.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard finish is fine for most basements. Choose a higher-end finish only if you want very smooth walls or expect bright lighting and glossy paint to expose flaws.
